name: Moon
blurb: LOLA laser altimetry and GRAIL gravity. Drawn from the Moon Planetary Modeling Atlas.

grids.label: Topography
grids.note: LOLA (MoonTopo2600p), heights above a 1737.151 km sphere. The far-side highlands and the South Pole–Aitken basin dominate the global shape.

grids.label: Free-air gravity
grids.note: GRAIL GRGM1200L at 1738 km, degrees 2–539. Red bullseyes on the near side are mascons, dense mare-filled basins.

grids.label: Bouguer gravity
grids.note: Free-air minus the pull of the topography (ρ = 2550 kg/m³). Highs mark thin crust under the big basins; lows mark thick far-side crust.

grids.label: Selenoid
grids.note: The lunar geoid from GRGM1200L degrees 2–180, height above a 1738 km sphere, including the tidal and rotational bulge.

images.label: Visible colour
images.note: LRO Wide Angle Camera colour mosaic (NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit), colour enhanced. Dark maria are iron-rich basalt; bright highlands are anorthosite.
